description:
VLCKit is an Objective-C wrapper for libvlc's external interface on macOS.

VENDORED COPY -- do not edit by hand except to bump the version.

Identical to the upstream VLCKit 3.7.3 podspec except for `source`, which points at a SkyStream release asset instead of download.videolan.org. VideoLAN publishes these frameworks nowhere else: no mirror carries /pub/cocoapods/, there are no GitHub release assets, and the SPM manifest points at the same host. So when that host went down on 2026-09-20 it took the macOS and iOS builds with it, and a podspec `source` accepts exactly one URL -- there is no mirror list to fall back to the way windows/CMakeLists.txt has one.

The payload is the upstream framework: it was unpacked from the CocoaPods cache, which CocoaPods had itself filled only after verifying VideoLAN's published archive against
  019afdae4e2e2d0f3ac325fac8f7ba0af25dca70b9d157df7d60db88e0be8e5d
  (https://download.videolan.org/pub/cocoapods/prod/VLCKit-3.7.3-319ed2c0-79128878.tar.xz)
The repacked tarball is byte-identical on extraction, verified with diff -rq, so the sha256 below is this archive's rather than VideoLAN's. To re-anchor to the upstream digest, download the URL above once that host is reachable, upload it under the same release tag, and restore both fields from the upstream spec.
